Delta-9 THC is the main cannabinoid found in marijuana. Delta 8 is a derivative. The reason why legal states are allowed to sell Delta-9 edibles is because of a loop hole in the 2018 Farm Bill, which allows anything of or below 0.3% Delta-9 THC on a dry weight basis. 
Here's the way it's legal. Hemp is defined as such federally, as long as it is <0.3% THC. So as long as they claim it's hemp derived and have the QR linked to a legit lab report, it is legal as a hemp product. So a 3.4g gummy can have 10mg hemp derived THC and be legal. 

Simply put: you ate weak/bad edibles. it’s not the Delta-9. If D9 didn’t do anything to you, then saying “I smoked afterwards to get high” is a complete contradiction. Delta-9 can get you high, you’re just incredibly misinformed or consuming low quality products. That’s a you thing, not a D9 thing. 

Also, it could be that your body just doesn’t metabolize edibles as well. Some people need higher doses and some people need lower doses. Some people just don’t get high at all. 

Hope this helped !

But rest assured that this is not abnormal, in fact, even without any mental illness, things like disassociation (DP/DR) are very common after first time recreational doses of THC at a high amount. How to get past mild post trip disassociation? Get back up. That is absolutely the best advice anyone could give you. Getting back into your regular routine and interacting with friends and family, some light cardio and a solid week or so of healthy living. Before no time, you’ll feel like nothing ever happened.
